A Fall Finish

Saturday and Sunday, November 7 and 8 · Plymouth Comfort Inn, 3000 Harbor Lane North

Two days of open stitching to get projects over the finish line, with a catered lunch, gift-certificate drawings each day and the free giveaway table. Bring anything you'd like to pass on. Whatever isn't claimed goes home with you.

Blackwork

One color of thread, counted stitches and a small motif repeated until it reads like lace. Stitchers in Tudor England wore it on their collars and cuffs, and it's still one of the most satisfying things to watch grow on a piece of linen.
